episodes.title: Yuki's World
episodes.summary: Yuki, who was born in a world where sounds don't sound like anything, runs into the enigmatic Itsuomi and immediately takes an interest in him.

episodes.title: To Affection
episodes.summary: Yuki tries to come to terms with her newfound feelings for Itsuomi, while Oushi offers a glimpse into what he's been trying to come to terms with for a long time.

episodes.title: Someone Is Thinking of Someone
episodes.summary: Having come to terms with her feelings for Itsuomi, Yuki prepares to make her move, but she encounters a sight that throws her into confusion and doubt.

episodes.title: What Kind of Voice?
episodes.summary: Having made plans with Kyouya to go shopping, Rin invites Yuki and Itsuomi to join them.

episodes.title: The Answer
episodes.summary: Itsuomi and Yuki have a chat at his place, and several lingering questions are answered.

episodes.title: Always Thought I Wanted to Be the Watchful Eye Forever
episodes.summary: Yuki and Kyouya each urge Itsuomi to make himself clear on where he stands in his relationship with Yuki, and he surprises them with his answer.

episodes.title: Let Me Introduce You to My Girlfriend
episodes.summary: Itsuomi is away on his trip, and Yuki is left trying to come to grips with their new reality.

episodes.title: One Small Step
episodes.summary: Being introduced to Yuki gets Shin reminiscing about his high school days with Itsuomi and Emma.

episodes.title: Promise
episodes.summary: Yuki faces her nerves before an interview for her part-time job, and Shin has to battle his to finally break the news to Emma.
